description: Samples graded by check_result.py --selftest. The rejected ones are what make a green run meaningful: a grader that accepts everything proves nothing. Two samples pin down the 0.2.0 advisory downgrade from both sides: nextjs-app.extra-fields.json must now be accepted (the closed schema used to reject it), and nextjs-app.quoted-evidence.json must still be rejected (the leak barrier the downgrade kept).
